handwritten_retrieval.description: UCI Multiple Features Handwritten cross-view retrieval using 100 paired samples and 1900 unpaired samples (Table 1).

k2p_r@1.description: Exact keypoint-to-pixel nearest-neighbor retrieval catches methods that only place the true pair somewhere in the top ten.

k2p_r@5.description: Keypoint-to-pixel recall at five measures tighter retrieval quality than the headline top-ten metric.

k2p_r@10.description: Keypoint-to-pixel recall at ten follows the paper's retrieval-style benefit metric.

p2k_r@1.description: Exact pixel-to-keypoint nearest-neighbor retrieval checks that the shared representation works in the reverse direction.

p2k_r@5.description: Pixel-to-keypoint recall at five measures reverse-direction retrieval before the broader top-ten cutoff.

p2k_r@10.description: Pixel-to-keypoint recall at ten prevents one-direction-only improvements from dominating the score.

mean_r@10.description: Average bidirectional recall at ten is the primary cross-view retrieval benefit metric.

mean_mrr.description: Average bidirectional reciprocal rank rewards placing the true pair near the top instead of merely inside the recall window.

mean_median_rank.description: Average bidirectional median true-pair rank penalizes methods with poor typical ranking despite acceptable recall cutoffs.

embedding_dim.description: Latent dimensionality is a compactness constraint so recall cannot be improved solely by expanding the representation.
